verdict.rationale: SoloKeys documents NFC tap-to-authenticate for compatible Android and iOS devices. GitHub describes Solo 2 as a USB+NFC passkey/WebAuthn device, and a community comment notes its stronger NFC. NFC appears to be part of a specific tier ('Everything in Solo 2 plus NFC'), and there is no detail on which mobile browsers or apps work. missing for 10: a documented compatibility list for mobile browsers and apps, clarity on which SKU includes NFC, hands-on corroboration of phone NFC authentication.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps
